📺 That Damn Michael Che (2021–2022)

That Damn Michael Che is a sketch comedy series starring comedian and Saturday Night Live personality Michael Che. Through a combination of creative sketches, personal reflections, and satirical storytelling, the series explores everyday experiences and complicated social issues from Che’s unique perspective. Each episode focuses on different themes, including relationships, racial inequality, unemployment, and the challenges of modern life. Featuring appearances from fellow comedians and celebrity guests, the show transforms uncomfortable situations into hilarious and thought-provoking moments. Combining sharp wit, dark humor, and unconventional storytelling, the series delivers entertaining comedy while examining human behavior, cultural differences, social expectations, and the absurdities of everyday life.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Satire • Sketch Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 7.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 25–30 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Michael Che

📺 Seasons: 2 • 12 Episodes

📺 Where to Watch: HBO Max (United States; availability may vary).
